english: For a real number $t$, let $\{t\}=t-[t]$, where $[t]$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $t$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\int_{1/4}^{1}\left\{\frac{1}{x}\right\}dx$ is ______.
hindi: वास्तविक संख्या $t$ के लिए माना $\{t\}=t-[t]$, जहाँ $[t]$, $t$ से कम या उसके बराबर महत्तम पूर्णांक को दर्शाता है। तब $\displaystyle\int_{1/4}^{1}\left\{\frac{1}{x}\right\}dx$ का मान ______ है।
solution: $\frac1x\in(n,n+1]$ for $x\in\left[\frac{1}{n+1},\frac1n\right)$; on such an interval $\left\{\frac1x\right\}=\frac1x-n$ (and $=0$ at $x=\frac1n$)
solution_full: For $x\in\left(\frac{1}{n+1},\frac1n\right)$, $\frac1x\in(n,n+1)$, so $\left[\frac1x\right]=n$ and $\left\{\frac1x\right\}=\frac1x-n$. The breakpoints in $\left[\frac14,1\right]$ are $\frac13$ and $\frac12$.
$\ln4=1.38629\ldots$, so the value is $0.30296\ldots$, which is $0.30$ to two decimal places.
originality_note: New: the fractional part of a reciprocal on a finite interval, whose breakpoints are 1/n (unequally spaced), giving a log sum minus a harmonic sum (way 2). Closest known: int_{1/2}^1 {1/x} dx = ln 2 - 1/2 (MathWorld) and int_0^1 {1/x} dx = 1 - gamma. Different because: three unequal pieces and a finite harmonic sum. The first design (int_0^1 {2x}{3x} dx) was replaced after allen.in showed int_0^1 ({2x}-1)({3x}-1) dx.
blueprint_concepts: Definite integrals of GIF and fractional part functions

concept_use.Definite integrals of GIF and fractional: {1/x} = 1/x - n on [1/(n+1), 1/n); the breakpoints 1/2, 1/3 come from the greatest integer function of 1/x.

stem_review: Read as a student: {t} and [t] are defined; integrand bounded. Checked: 2 ln 2 - 13/12 = 0.30296 (quadrature agrees). Answer 0.30 lies between 0 and 1 as planned. Changed: redesigned after the web check (see originality note).
key_step: Locate the breakpoints 1/2, 1/3 where [1/x] jumps, then integrate 1/x - n on each piece.
justification: Routine chain: find breakpoints, three log integrals, a short harmonic sum. Lighter than 2021-P2-Q19 (L4) because the breakpoints are obvious; L2.
